lines.text: Ana's family was ready for the mall.
She took them to a trail instead.
Here's the fix. Pick a trail shorter than you think.
Dress everyone in layers, not cotton.
And be back well before dark, because the sun sets early now.
They ended at a lookout, laughing.
Our Beginner's Hiking Guide is twenty-five percent off through December first.
